name: UnADF
runtimeDependencies: AmigaOS 3.0 or later and a 68020 or later, with 2 MiB of Fast RAM recommended
xfdmaster.library for optional compressed ADF input
notes: The Aminet archive supplies the original 2.1.12 Shell command and the installed English readme. BCWB ships no command icon or saved settings.
Directory Opus invokes UnADF for listing and extraction. Its configuration keeps its current owner. The shared xfdmaster.library is outside this package.

The development command seeks to the logical EOF before truncating extraction output. It accepts standard DD and HD gzip-compressed ADFs via the installed XFD GZip slave and returns an error when the image cannot be loaded or opened.
